modelOverview: The Tank Solo is Cartier's entry-level interpretation of the archetypal Tank silhouette, launched in 2004 as a more accessible, contemporary alternative to the Tank Française and Tank Louis Cartier. The Large model wears a longer, more elongated case than the standard size while keeping the collection's clean Roman numeral dial and railway minute track, and was produced in both quartz and automatic references before being succeeded by newer Tank Solo generations.

W5200003.materials: Stainless steel case on a black alligator leather strap
W5200003.dial: Silver opaline dial with Roman numerals, railway minute track and sword-shaped blued-steel hands
W5200003.description: The Tank Solo Large in steel is Cartier's clean, quartz-powered take on the marque's foundational Tank silhouette, distinguished by its elongated 34.8mm x 27.4mm case, silver opaline dial and blued sword hands. Now a discontinued reference, examples are increasingly sought after as an accessible entry into Cartier's dress watch line. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
